terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your access to and use of MepMail, a transactional email service operated by Je4nDev ("we", "us"). By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

sections.title: 1. The service
body: MepMail lets you send transactional email through an HTTPS API, an SMTP relay, or an MCP server, and to manage sending domains, contacts, suppressions and delivery events. Email is delivered through Amazon SES, which acts as our delivery infrastructure.

The service is offered in tiers: Free and Starter have a daily sending limit, and Pro and Scale include a monthly volume. You are responsible for choosing the tier that fits your volume. On Free and Starter, sends beyond the daily limit wait in a queue and are never billed; on monthly Pro and Scale, sends beyond the included volume are billed as overage, which comes switched on and can be turned off in Billing, as described on the pricing page.

sections.title: 2. Your account
body: You must provide accurate account information, keep your credentials and API keys secret, and be at least 18 years old (or the age of majority where you live). You are responsible for all activity under your account and for the content you send.
You must have a lawful basis to email the recipients you upload or send to — typically their consent or an existing customer relationship.

sections.title: 3. Acceptable use
body: MepMail is for permission-based transactional and marketing email. You must not use the service to:
list: Send unsolicited bulk email (spam) or email to purchased, rented or scraped lists.
Send phishing, malware, fraudulent or deceptive messages, or spoof sender identity.
Impersonate another person, brand or institution (banks, government agencies, carriers, insurers, account-security notices), including with domains that look like another brand's.
Register or send from domains you do not control, such as public or disposable email domains.
Send content that is illegal, harassing, hateful or infringing.
Process data you do not have the right to process.
Probe, overload or attempt to bypass the service's limits, quotas or security, including by switching sender, domain or account to escape blocks or reviews.

sections.title: 4. Spam complaints and reputation
body: Email deliverability depends on sender reputation. If your sending generates spam complaints, bounces or blocklist listings, we may pause sending, require changes, or suspend the account. In severe cases we may terminate immediately without refund, as described in the Refund Policy.

sections.title: 5. Plans, billing and overage
body: Paid plans are billed in US dollars through Stripe, monthly or yearly, in advance. Volume is counted per distinct recipient, like our delivery infrastructure does. On monthly Pro and Scale, sends beyond the included volume are billed at the plan's overage rate, up to 5× that volume; overage comes switched on and can be turned off in Billing. Annual plans, Free and Starter have no overage billing.
If a payment fails, we may suspend sending until it is settled. Prices may change with at least 30 days' notice; changes never apply retroactively to a period you already paid.

sections.title: 6. Cancellation
body: You can cancel at any time from the dashboard. Cancellation stops future renewals; the account remains active until the end of the paid period and then moves to the free tier with its sending limits. Refunds are covered by the Refund Policy.

sections.title: 7. Availability and delivery
body: We aim for high availability, but during the open beta the service is provided "as is", without a guaranteed SLA. We may perform maintenance and may change or discontinue features.

We cannot guarantee that any individual email will be accepted, delivered or read: recipient servers, filters and blocklists are outside our control. Our delivery infrastructure's event data is the reference for what happened to a message.

sections.title: 8. Suspension and termination
body: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms, if required by law, or to protect the service, recipients or other customers. You may delete your account at any time.

When there are signs of phishing, fraud, impersonation or any other use prohibited in section 3, we may suspend the account immediately and without notice, even before its first send. A suspension revokes every API and SMTP key and every integration's access, removes the account's domains from our sending infrastructure and cancels any email still queued.

Accounts suspended for these reasons are not eligible for a refund of any amount paid, including within the 7-day guarantee, and chargebacks will be disputed with the evidence of the case. We may share that evidence with our infrastructure providers and with authorities when required or to stop the abuse.
Sections that by their nature should survive termination (billing, liability, governing law) survive.

sections.title: 9. Intellectual property
body: The MepMail software is open source under the AGPL and can be self-hosted; the hosted service, brand and documentation are ours. Your data — contacts, messages and domains — remains yours. We claim no ownership over it.

sections.title: 10. Liability
body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total liability for claims related to the service is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages, lost profits, or the content sent through the service. Nothing here excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law.

sections.title: 11. Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. Material changes are announced by email or on this page at least 15 days before they take effect. Continuing to use the service after the effective date means you accept the new terms.

sections.title: 12. Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of Brazil, where the service is operated. Disputes are settled in the courts of Paranavaí, Paraná, Brazil, unless mandatory consumer law in your country provides otherwise.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data MepMail collects, how it is used and what choices you have. It is short on purpose: collect little, encrypt what is sensitive and name the providers.

sections.title: 1. In short
list: We collect the data needed to run the account, Send, Correio and billing. Advertising measurement is optional, depends on your permission and never runs in the Android app.
The content of emails, sent and received, and attachments are encrypted at rest. We do not sell that content and do not use it to train AI models.
To protect everyone's delivery, a sample of the emails sent through Send goes through an automated abuse check by an AI provider named below.
Payments run on Stripe, by card or Pix; we never see or store your card number.
We work with a short list of providers, named below, including the AI ones behind the abuse check and support.
You can export or delete your data at any time.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
list: Account: name, email, password (stored as a hash) and team membership. If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email and profile picture from it.
Billing: plan, payment status and invoice references. Card data goes straight to Stripe; with Pix, Stripe creates and confirms the payment.

Send: sending domains, the contacts and audiences you add, suppressions, templates, broadcasts and message metadata (recipient, subject, status and delivery events). When you turn tracking on for a domain, also the recipients' open and click events.
Send message content: the HTML and text you send, encrypted at rest.
Correio: the received and sent messages, drafts and attachments of your mailboxes, encrypted at rest, plus folders, rules, approved or blocked senders and preferences.

External accounts you connect (Gmail, Outlook, Hotmail, Microsoft 365 and others): the app password or, when you sign in with Microsoft or Google, only the refresh token, stored encrypted; and copies of that account's Inbox messages.

Support: the conversations in the support chat and by email, with the images you attach. When you are signed in, the chat receives your account's identification (name, email, team, plan and mailbox count).
Technical data: IP address, user agent, session cookies and application and API request logs, with secrets redacted.

Optional advertising measurement: public pages visited, Meta and Google cookie and click identifiers, clicks to create an account, the sign-up completion and checkout-start and first paid-plan purchase events, with value and currency. We do not send names, emails, phone numbers, contacts, recipients or message content for this purpose.

sections.title: 3. How we use data
list: To provide the service: authenticate you, deliver email through Amazon SES, receive and store Correio email, sync the external accounts you connect, show delivery events and enforce quotas and limits.
To bill and process refunds.
To protect the service: detect abuse, spam and phishing, including the automated check of a sample of the emails sent through Send, and prevent unauthorized access; and to meet legal obligations.
To help you in support.
To contact you about your account or material changes to the service.

sections.title: 4. Correio, external accounts and mailbox features
body: Your mailboxes' messages are stored encrypted, with per-team keys. Only the people and agents with access to a mailbox read it through MepMail. Our team does not read mailbox content, except with your consent, for security or when the law requires it.
list: External accounts: MepMail reads the Inbox of the account you connect without marking, moving or deleting anything at the provider. The first time, it brings the last 30 days of messages (up to 500); then the new ones, every few minutes. Replies leave through the provider's own sending server, with your address. When you disconnect, we delete the copies and the credential; nothing changes at the provider.
Search: mailbox search uses a blind index. Each word becomes a code (HMAC) under a key of your team, and the index stores no text. The searches you make are not kept as history.
Translation: the Translate button uses your browser's own translator, on your device. MepMail sends the content to no translation service.

Sender pictures: to show the sender's logo or picture, our server looks up the BIMI record and the website icon of the sender's domain (for authenticated email only) and Gravatar, with a code (hash) of the sender's address. The lookups leave from our server, so these services do not see who is reading.

AI agents: if you connect an agent (MCP or API) to a mailbox, it reaches only what you allow, and sends can require your approval. You choose the agent's provider, which handles the data under its own terms.

sections.title: 5. Google and Microsoft data
body: When you connect a Google (Gmail) or Microsoft (Outlook, Hotmail, Microsoft 365) account, MepMail uses the access granted only to read that account's Inbox and send the messages you write from it, inside Correio. We do not use this data for advertising, do not sell it and do not transfer it to third parties, except to the infrastructure providers needed to run the feature, for security or when the law requires it. No one on our team reads these messages, except with your consent, for security or when the law requires it.
MepMail's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
You can withdraw the access at any time: disconnect the account in MepMail, or remove the access in your Google or Microsoft account's security settings.

sections.title: 6. Legal bases
body: Where the GDPR applies, we process data to perform our contract with you (running the service), on the basis of legitimate interest (security and abuse prevention), to meet legal obligations (billing records) and with your consent where required (non-essential cookies and connecting external accounts). Under the LGPD, the corresponding bases apply.

sections.title: 7. Providers
body: We use a deliberately short list of providers to run the service. Page metrics use Umami, which we host on our own servers, with no cookies and no cross-site tracking.

If you allow advertising measurement, Meta and Google receive the optional events described in this policy: Meta through the Pixel and the sign-up completion and purchase events, Google through Google Analytics on public pages and the sign-up completion and first paid-plan purchase events, which our server sends with the Meta and Google Analytics cookie identifiers and, for the purchase, the plan and value. These connections also share the IP address and browser information. Each company handles this data under its own privacy policy. We do not turn on Google signals or ad personalization, and measurement is not needed to use MepMail.
list: Contabo GmbH (Germany) — hosting for the application, the database, the Elozi support platform and our own metrics.

Amazon Web Services (United States; Ireland as a fallback) — Amazon SES delivers the Send and Correio emails and receives the mailboxes' emails, with the messages' content and metadata. The copy of each received email sits in private, encrypted storage (Amazon S3), set to expire after 30 days. The event queues (SQS and SNS) and the encryption keys (KMS) also run on AWS.
Stripe — card and Pix payments, invoices and receipts.

Cloudflare — DNS, CDN and network protection in front of our servers; the Turnstile challenge that can protect sign-in, sign-up and password reset; and storage (R2) of the database backups and of the images you upload (profile picture and team and signature logos, published by link).

Command Code (Langbase, Inc., United States) — automated abuse check. It receives a sample of the emails already accepted by Send: sender, reply-to address, subject, visible text, link domains and attachment names, plus the team's name, plan, age and verified domains; never the recipients. It answers whether they show signs of phishing or spam with the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model, which Command Code forwards to providers that host the model, under their terms. Under Command Code's policy, this content may be kept for up to 30 days to run and protect the service (we do not use its zero-retention mode) and is not used to train its models. It receives no Correio or external-account content.

Elozi (JE4NDEV's own support platform, the company behind MepMail, hosted on our servers) — the support chat and the suporte@mepmail.dev email, with AI assistants and human support. The conversations are stored in Elozi.
Gravatar (Automattic) — receives the code (hash) of a sender's address to show their picture.

OpenCode Go (Anomaly, United States) — the AI models (DeepSeek) of the support assistants: they receive the messages of the conversation or the support email, your account's identification when you are signed in and the images you attach. OpenCode states that it does not store this content and passes it to the model's provider. For the text model in use it publishes zero retention under an agreement renewed every month; the model that reads images has no published period.
Telegram — internal notices to our team about each new sign-up: email, name, language and where the sign-up came from (campaign and landing page).

sections.title: 8. Retention
body: Account and Correio data are kept while the account is active. In Send, message content is deleted 30 days after sending; the metadata (recipient, subject, status and events) and the API request logs also go after 30 days, leaving only counters and aggregate results. Abuse-check results (score and reason, without the content) are kept for 90 days.

In Correio, a message stays until you delete it: emptying the trash or deleting forever removes it at once. Messages sent from Correio stay as the record of the send. A deleted mailbox can be restored for 30 days and is then erased with its messages. The receiving copy at AWS expires after 30 days, and backup copies within 30 days. An external account's copies and its credential are deleted when you disconnect it.

After an account is deleted, we remove personal data within 30 days, except where retention is required (for example, billing records kept for tax and accounting obligations) or where limited delivery logs are needed for security. Aggregated, non-identifiable statistics may be kept.

The advertising preference can be withdrawn through the footer link. Withdrawal stops new sends and cancels events still pending; it does not delete events that already reached Meta or Google. We do not send events from before your permission.

sections.title: 9. Security
body: Traffic is encrypted in transit (TLS). Message content, attachments and external-account credentials are encrypted at rest. Passwords are stored as hashes. Access to production systems is limited to the operator, and API keys are stored only as hashes, with a short prefix for identification.

sections.title: 10. Apps
body: The Windows, Linux, macOS and Android apps show the same service as the website and follow this policy. The desktop app can keep a copy of messages for offline reading on the device itself, deleted when you sign out. The Android app shows no purchases and runs no advertising measurement.

sections.title: 11. Your rights
body: Depending on where you live, you can ask to access, correct, port, restrict or delete your personal data, and object to processing. You can delete your account directly in the dashboard and reach us at jean@mepmail.dev for any privacy request. We answer within 30 days.

sections.title: 12. International transfers
body: The application, the database and Elozi run in Germany (Contabo). AWS (in the United States and, as a fallback, Ireland), Stripe, Command Code, OpenCode, Gravatar and Telegram process data in the United States and other countries where they operate, and Cloudflare operates worldwide. Where the provider offers them, transfers rely on its standard contractual clauses or equivalent safeguards.

sections.title: 13. Cookies
body: Essential cookies keep the session, the language and your advertising preference. Optional Meta cookies, such as _fbp and _fbc, and Google cookies, such as _ga and _gcl_aw, are used only after you allow measurement. The preference starts without permission; refusing or withdrawing it keeps the service working. The “Advertising preferences” link in the footer lets you review the choice. Measurement is limited to the public offer pages and to confirmed checkout and payment events, with no dashboard or mailbox content. In the Android app there is no advertising measurement, even if the browser has the permission.

sections.title: 14. Changes
body: We may update this policy. Material changes are announced by email or on this page before they take effect.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: We want you to pay only if MepMail works for you. The free tier exists so you can validate the service with real email before spending anything.

sections.title: 1. Test free first
body: Every account starts free, with a daily sending ceiling and access to the full API, SMTP relay and MCP server. We recommend sending real email on the free tier before choosing a paid plan.

sections.title: 2. 7-day guarantee on your first payment
body: If you upgrade and are not satisfied, ask us within 7 days of your first payment and we refund it in full — no interrogation. One guarantee per account, on the first paid period. The guarantee does not apply to accounts suspended for violating the Terms of Service (see section 6).

sections.title: 3. After the first 7 days
body: After that window, payments are non-refundable and we do not refund unused volume pro-rata: you can cancel at any time and keep sending until the end of the paid period, then the account moves to the free tier.

sections.title: 4. Duplicate or accidental charges
body: If you were charged twice, charged after a cancellation, or charged by mistake, contact us and we refund the charge in full — this is not subject to the 7-day window.

sections.title: 5. Platform failures
body: If a send fails due to a technical failure on our side (not recipient-side filters, blocklists or bounces), tell us with the message IDs. We investigate and credit the affected volume or refund the equivalent amount, as appropriate.

sections.title: 6. Abuse and spam
body: Accounts suspended or terminated for violating the Terms of Service — spam, purchased lists, phishing, fraud, impersonating a person or brand, prohibited content — are not eligible for a refund of any amount, including within the 7-day guarantee.
A suspension may happen before anything is sent when there are clear signs of abuse. Chargebacks in these cases are disputed with the evidence.

sections.title: 7. How to request a refund
body: Email jean@mepmail.dev from your account address (or tell us the account email) with the charge reference. Refunds are processed through Stripe back to the original payment method, typically within 5–10 business days depending on your bank.

sections.title: 8. Cancelling vs refunding
body: Cancelling stops future charges; it does not refund past ones. You can cancel from the dashboard at any time — no phone call, no retention maze.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy. Changes apply to future purchases from the effective date, never retroactively.
